newsitem.title: USA: Coors sees Q3 net at $17 mln to $19 mln.
newsitem.headline: Coors sees Q3 net at $17 mln to $19 mln.

text.p: Adolph Coors Co the holding company for Coors Brewing Co, said on Monday it expected to report net income between $17 million and $19 million for the third quarter ended September 29, 1996.

The company, which will formally release earnings on October 31, said the figure included $4.8 million of pretax income from the Molson royalty payment as well as the net effect of other special items.
Excluding special items like the royalty payments, it put after-tax earnings at between $13 million to $15 million.
For the same period last year, the company said it had earned a net income of $16.5 million, or $0.43 per share.
